description: Bluetooth BR/EDR shell module providing commands for Bluetooth operations such as connect, discovery, SDP, and security PIN entry.

methods.name: cmd_auth_pincode
methods.description: Handles setting the PIN code for Bluetooth pairing.

methods.name: cmd_connect
methods.description: Initiates a BR/EDR connection to a specified Bluetooth address.

methods.name: br_device_found
methods.description: Processes a found Bluetooth device during discovery.

methods.name: br_discovery_complete
methods.description: Callback invoked when BR/EDR device discovery completes.

methods.name: cmd_discovery
methods.description: Starts or stops BR/EDR device discovery.

methods.name: l2cap_recv
methods.description: Handles incoming data on an L2CAP channel.

methods.name: cmd_l2cap_register
methods.description: Registers an L2CAP server with specified PSM.

methods.name: cmd_oob
methods.description: Retrieves local Out-Of-Band data for BR/EDR.

methods.name: sdp_hfp_ag_user
methods.description: Processes SDP results for Hands-Free Profile Audio Gateway.

methods.name: sdp_a2src_user
methods.description: Processes SDP results for A2DP source.

methods.name: cmd_sdp_find_record
methods.description: Initiates SDP record discovery for specific UUIDs.

methods.name: cmd_br
methods.description: Main handler for 'br' shell command, dispatches subcommands.
